findings.detail: Current-period debt rows in the source schedule have blank Interest Term and Interest Rate cells, leaving no rate or basis-spread value for private-credit income calculations.

rationale: X02 flags private-credit rows missing both interest_rate and basis_spread. The raw investment schedule header identifies the relevant columns as Interest Term and Interest Rate, and the cited current-period debt rows omit both columns while still reporting debt instruments, maturity, principal/par, cost, percentage of net assets, and fair value. This confirms a real missing-rate data condition rather than an aggregate-anchor issue or an equity/classification false alarm.
